technical.summary: COST shows solid bullish structure (EMA golden cross, price above key MAs, supertrend bullish) but multiple overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry conviction; better suited for pullback entry or confirmation of momentum continuation.

fundamental.summary: COST shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, imminent earnings in 31 days, and absent government/lobbying/retail indicators.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 36.7% vs bullish 28.4%) with greed-zone reading (60) suggests neutral positioning; insufficient news data to confirm or contradict setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (185.28) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC event in 2 days adds binary risk, and earnings in 31 days present additional volatility catalyst.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross, supertrend bullish, and price above cloud provide solid technical structure for continuation if momentum sustains through FOMC event.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple overbought oscillators (Stoch 90.21, RSI, Williams %R, UO), weak ADX trend confirmation, macro crisis (VIX 185.28, inverted yield curve), imminent FOMC binary event, and high earnings risk in 31 days create excessive downside risk relative to reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive (EMA golden cross, supertrend bullish) but severely undermined by overbought oscillators, weak trend confirmation (ADX false), and macro crisis conditions (VIX 185.28, inverted yield curve). Risk/reward is unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days and earnings in 31 days create binary volatility catalysts; overbought conditions invite mean reversion into macro headwinds; existing COST position and 51 Consumer Staples holdings create concentration drag.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical score (7) insufficient to overcome fundamental (3), sentiment (5), and risk (2) weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding COST with 51 open Consumer Staples positions (11.8% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further; macro environment hostile to new swing entries.
